description: Returns the rates of ONE commodity symbol through a single UTC day at a chosen interval (1m to 1d). Each point is the rate recorded at that exact mark (e.g. 14:05 = the rate observed at 14:05 UTC), not an OHLC bar; 'rates' is keyed by ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. At most 100 points per call: if 'nextStartTime' in the result is not null, call again with startTime set to it to get the next page (from 15m upward a whole day fits in one call). Marks with no recorded rate are left out, so 'count' can be below 100. Only symbols updated every second, minute or 10 minutes have intraday data (others return 400 BAD_REQUEST); symbols updated every 10 minutes accept only intervals that are multiples of 10 minutes (10m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, 1d). Rates are in the symbol's own currency (no quote conversion). Available on the Advanced and Enterprise plans only; other plans get 402.

date.description: The UTC day to read, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Cannot be in the future; for today, points stop at the current UTC minute.

metadata.description: Whether to include the 'metadata' map (per-symbol unit and quote currency) in the response. Defaults to true. Set false to omit it and get a smaller payload.

startTime.description: First mark of the window as a 24-hour UTC time in HH:mm. Defaults to 00:00. Must fall on a mark of the interval (14:30 works for 5m or 30m but not 1h; for 1d only 00:00). Pass the previous result's 'nextStartTime' to page through the day.

symbol.description: Exactly one commodity symbol, e.g. 'XAU'. Common names with a single match (e.g. GOLD) are auto-resolved and flagged in 'unresolved' with 'resolvedTo'. See list_symbols for valid values.

name: get_intraday_rates
title: Get intraday commodity rates
